summary: PM3: develop plugins against an installed DevHub (DEVHUB_PLUGIN_PATHS, F5)
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `9c5114f`: PM3: plugin development against an installed DevHub — DEVHUB_PLUGIN_PATHS loads plugins from build folders (they win over bundled/installed copies and are on for the run; PluginFolders.ScanPaths/WithDevelopment, tested); plugin repo: build output becomes a plugin folder and a generated launchSettings.json starts DevHub with it (F5, own data folder); build/Test-Plugins.ps1 runs the plugin matrix against those folders
